Sample fixture content.

A escaped script bullet reads <script>alert('x')</script> and stays text.

An escaped image bullet reads <img onerror=x> and stays text.

onerror= and onclick= as bare words in prose are not attributes.

Markup inside a quoted attribute value is inert.

An unquoted attribute value that reads onerror=x is a value, not a handler.

An unquoted query value holding online=1 is not a handler.

A javascript: scheme named in a non-URL attribute is inert.

data-* attributes are not URL attributes.
